Dexter's Laboratory,Science,Invention,La.Desc: Dexter ek chhota scientist hai jiska ek secret lab hota hai uske bedroom mein. Har din naye inventions aur experiments karta hai, lekin uski behan Dee Dee hamesha uske plans bigaad deti hai.

Powerpuff Girls,Superhero,Girls,Townsvil.Desc: Blossom, Bubbles aur Buttercup teen chhoti superheroes hain jo Townsville ko villains se bachati hain. Inki shaktiyon ka istemal karke ye har mushkil ka samna karti hain.

Ed Edd n Eddy,Friends,Neighborhood,Scams.Desc: Teen dost Ed, Edd aur Eddy har din naye plans banate hain taaki jawbreakers kharid sakein. Unke mazedaar aur funny adventures aapko hansa denge.

Courage the Cowardly Dog,Horror,Farm,Dog.Desc: Courage ek darpok kutta hai jo apne malik Muriel aur Eustace ke saath ek farm mein rehta hai. Har episode mein vo ajeebo gareeb monsters se unki raksha karta hai.

Johnny Bravo,Narcissist,Muscles,Girls.Desc: Johnny Bravo ek muscular aur stylish ladka hai jo hamesha ladkiyon ko impress karne ki koshish karta hai, lekin har baar fail ho jata hai. Uski harkatein bahut funny hoti hain.

Kim Possible,Spy,Teen,Adventure.Desc: Kim Possible ek high school ki ladki hai jo secret agent bhi hai. Apne dost Ron aur pet Rufus ke saath milkar duniya ko villains se bachati hai.

Totally Spies,Agents,Fashion,Action.Desc: Teen college girls - Sam, Clover aur Alex - secret agents hain jo stylish outfits mein duniya bhar ke missions complete karti hain.

The Grim Adventures of Billy & Mandy,Gri.Desc: Billy aur Mandy ne Grim Reaper ko harakar use apna dost bana liya hai. Ab teeno milkar creepy aur funny adventures mein hissa lete hain.

Codename: Kids Next Door,Treehouse,Agent.Desc: Paanch bacche ek secret organization banate hain jiska mission hai badon ke rules ke khilaf ladna. Unka treehouse headquarters bahut hi cool hai.

Foster’s Home for Imaginary Friends,Imag.Desc: Foster's ek aisa ghar hai jahan imaginary friends rehte hain jab unke creators bade ho jate hain. Mac aur Blooregard ke adventures yahan hote hain.

Recess,Playground,School,Kids.Desc: Chhe school ke bacche apne playground mein ek mini society banate hain jahan unke apne rules aur leaders hote hain. Har din ek nayi kahani hoti hai.

Lilo & Stitch,Aliens,Ohana,Hawaii.Desc: Lilo ek Hawaiian ladki hai jo Stitch naam ke alien ko adopt karti hai. Dono milkar family aur dosti ka matlab samajhte hain.

Rocket Power,Skateboarding,Sports,Beach.Desc: Otto, Reggie, Twister aur Sam chaar dost hain jo skateboarding aur surfing jaise extreme sports mein maharat rakhte hain. Unke beachside adventures bahut exciting hote hain.

The Wild Thornberrys,Animals,Travel,Fami.Desc: Eliza Thornberry apni family ke saath duniya bhar mein travel karti hai aur uske paas animals se baat karne ki special power hoti hai.

Static Shock,Superhero,Electricity,Teen.Desc: Virgil Hawkins ek teenager hai jo Static ban kar electricity ke powers se crime se ladta hai. Uske adventures action se bhare hote hain.

Oswald,Octopus,Friendship,Peaceful.Desc: Oswald ek blue octopus hai jo apne pet Weenie ke saath ek peaceful city mein rehta hai. Uski kahaniyan dosti aur kindness se bhari hoti hain.

Noddy,Toyland,Car,Adventure.Desc: Noddy ek wooden boy hai jo Toyland mein apni red-and-yellow car chala kar adventures karta hai aur apne doston ki madad karta hai.

Mr. Bean (Animated),Silent,Comedy,Mischi.Desc: Mr. Bean ka animated version uske silent aur funny antics ko dikhata hai jahan vo apne teddy ke saath funny situations mein fas jata hai.

Dragon Tales,Dragons,Fantasy,Kids.Desc: Emmy aur Max ek magical dragon scale ke zariye Dragon Land jaate hain jahan vo dragons ke saath milkar naye lessons seekhte hain.
